bio: Marcantonio embodies patience distilled through years of waiting at docks before dawn, observing the rhythms of commerce, and learning when to act and when to remain still. His approach to business reflects this same measured pace—cautious investments, careful expansion, and a preference for steady returns over risky ventures.
